how: Each shot was taken in-session from the game itself: serve the game, open the scene URL in headless Chromium at 1280x720, let it run, screenshot, convert to JPEG.

shots.caption: Three-star police chase in the Vortex Coupe: wanted stars, minimap and mission marker on the HUD.
Driving the Sunspire Taxi through downtown traffic on foot of the plaza.
